    How the List Is Built

    For each person, the server asks the sources that are on, top to bottom, drops what the filters exclude, and stops once every library has its number of titles. Drawn from the saved settings.

      Only the three Seerr sources use it. The key stays on the server.

      In Seerr: Settings, General, API key.
      TMDb popularity score of a Seerr suggestion. 0 takes everything Seerr suggests.

      In Plain Words

      From the saved filters. They apply to every source.

      star

      Quality

      Keeps blurry, unrated or very old titles out of the spotlight.

      Community rating out of 10. Above 0, titles without a rating are left out.
      star
      Made in this year or later. 0 means any year; above 0, titles without a year are left out.
      Minimum backdrop sizeThe width of the backdrop image, not the video. Small backdrops look blurry across a TV. Above Any, titles without a backdrop are left out; sizes Jellyfin does not know are kept.
      Recommended: without one the slide is a plain dark area.
      Stricter. Without it, slides with no logo show the title as text (see Details & buttons).
      Media typesSingle episodes and music are left out on purpose: they lack large backdrops.

      Slideshow

      infoWith the transition None, slides never advance by themselves.
      infoOnly matters while slides advance automatically.
      Left and right on the home screen, also with a TV remote. The preview here ignores them.

      Order

      Off: the order of the sources, with the libraries taking turns. The order then stays until the next build.
      Each home screen visit gets its own order, in the browser. Costs the server nothing. The preview keeps the list order.
      update

      List Freshness

      How long a built list is kept. Page views in between cost the server practically nothing.

      home

      Where It Appears

      homeHome screen only. The banner sits above the home sections, for every user and every web browser or app that uses the Jellyfin web interface. It is never shown on other pages, so there is nothing to set here.
